samples.question: Inside the single framed square panel, find its upright 24-by-24 microcell raster. Apply the declared 3-by-3 box blur: average each non-overlapping 3-by-3 block of microcells into one output cell, then mark the output cell dark when its mean RGB is darker than the midpoint of the two visible microcell tones. Read the resulting 8-by-8 bitmap and compare it with A or ). Answer A or B; a tie or a template gap below 8 is quarantined. Ignore remote marks.
